Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect delete this Digimon even when my opponent has no Digimon?

Effect: [End of Opponent’s Turn] By deleting this Digimon, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Loogamon] or [Eiji Nagasumi] from your trash without paying the cost.
